newsitem.title: USA: Impath buys Immunodiagnostic Labs assets.
newsitem.headline: Impath buys Immunodiagnostic Labs assets.

text.p: Impath Inc said it bought certain assets of Immunodiagnostic Laboratories Inc, a Florida-based oncology and immunology lab that specializes in analyzing lymphomas and leukemias.
Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
Impath said the assets it bought include Immunodiagnostic's business client list and information relating to Immunodiagnostic's cancer diagnostic and prognostic testing business.
Impath shares were unchanged in early trading Friday at 16-1/2.
